title: P0a: attribution on every run row — bus.log_run enriches each row with bucket (planner, scout, execute, fix_round, spec_review, review, challenge, jev, memory, other), fix-round lineage, executor and model, complexity band and task class; normalized token fields actually written for Claude and Codex rows; Codex usd estimated from tokens with usd_source; Jev usage rows carry task, goal and bucket
spec:
Phase I P0 (brief .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md, section P0). Base goal/T-0445 (= Phase H head 0d7bf09). Scout facts: bus.log_run (bus.py:269-284) appends one JSON line per call to runs/<date>.jsonl; Claude rows come from spawn.run_claude (spawn.py:409-439) with task, role, tier, account, duration_s, outcome, usd, turns, provider, executor, complexity, packet_meta and raw usage; Codex rows from executor._run (executor.py:107-140) carry tokens but never usd; planner rows from planner_runs (planner_runs.py:570-609); Jev usage goes only to runs/jev/<date>.jsonl (jev.py:7-20) and gate.jsonl (jev_gate.py:16). VERIFIED: bus.normalize_usage (bus.py:221-244) builds input_uncached_tokens, cache_read_tokens, total_tokens, yet no row on disk carries them: find why the callers (executor._tokens executor.py:88-94, 139-140; spawn.py:435-440) do not land them and fix it at the source.

1. New module orchestrator/attribution.py (imports bus and stdlib only): bucket_of(role, task) -> one of planner, scout, execute, fix_round, spec_review, review, challenge, jev, memory, other (role planner_decision or planner -> planner; role execute with constraints.fix_round_for or constraints.auto_round -> fix_round, else execute; scout/triage -> scout; spec_review, review, challenge by role; jev, memory by role; anything else -> other); lineage(task) -> {"root": <the execute task the fix-round chain repairs, following constraints.fix_round_for to the end>, "round_index": <int, 0 for the root>}; band(complexity) -> the same bands scorecard._band uses (move or share the mapping so both agree); model_of(executor_id, tier, pool_cfg) -> the pool.toml executor row model for Codex ids or the [models] entry for a Claude tier, else None.
2. bus.log_run: after the existing field handling, when a task id is present it loads the task and adds bucket, lineage_root, round_index, band, task_class (scorecard.task_class logic moved into attribution.task_class, scorecard keeps a thin alias so its tests stay green), executor, model; without a task id it adds bucket from role alone (other when unknown). Use a deferred import of attribution inside log_run (bus is imported by attribution). Existing fields are never renamed or removed: additive only, so every scorecard test that pins row shapes still passes.
3. Normalized tokens on every row with usage: input_uncached_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens via bus.normalize_usage(provider, usage) for both providers; keep the raw usage dict too. Add a regression test that reads a written row back from a temp runs dir and asserts the five fields.
4. usd on Codex rows: derive from tokens with the helper H4 added for the reservation ledger (grep usd_of in the repo; reuse it, do not duplicate) and record usd_source = "token_estimate"; Claude rows keep the reported usd and get usd_source = "reported"; rows without usage get usd absent and usd_source absent.
5. Jev usage rows (jev.py writer of runs/jev/<date>.jsonl): add task, goal_id (from the task when known), role = "jev", bucket = "jev", and the normalized token fields when the API response carries usage, so scorecard can join them by task; gate.jsonl unchanged.
Tests: tests/test_attribution.py: test_bucket_of_every_role, test_fix_round_bucket_and_lineage_root_follow_chain, test_band_matches_scorecard, test_model_of_codex_and_claude; tests/test_bus.py: test_log_run_enriches_bucket_lineage_band_class, test_log_run_without_task_uses_other_bucket, test_log_run_writes_normalized_tokens_for_claude_and_codex, test_codex_usd_estimated_with_source, test_claude_usd_reported_with_source; tests/test_jev.py: test_jev_usage_row_carries_task_goal_bucket. Keep every existing test green (tests/test_scorecard.py pins row shapes; fields are additive). .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A; commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: every run row written by spawn.run_claude, executor._run and planner_runs carries bucket, band, executor, model and the five normalized token fields when usage exists; Codex rows carry usd with usd_source token_estimate; no existing field renamed or removed
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
